title: Projects
description: Projects by Francisco Valencia: SpiderFinance, Cliponomicon, and other work.
lede: Backend development, APIs, databases, and software architecture.
otherIntro: Other apps and work in progress.
teamDescription: Cliponomicon was developed with contributions from several people.
spiderfinanceSummary: Multi-user web platform for organizing and reviewing personal finances.
spiderfinanceDescription: Web application for organizing and reviewing personal finances. It includes a REST API, data persistence, authentication, and a web interface, and is deployed with containers.
cliponomiconApiSummary: Platform for uploading, processing, storing, and serving videos, with an administration interface.
cliponomiconApiDescription: Modular backend for video uploads, asynchronous processing, storage, and delivery. It includes FFmpeg transcoding, thumbnail generation, authentication, and an administration interface. This is a collaborative project.
spiderportfolioSummary: Portfolio application with a visual editor, reusable components, and publishable content.
spiderportfolioDescription: Portfolio application with a visual page editor, reusable components, and separate workflows for drafts, previews, and publishing.
spidertomp3Summary: Desktop application for downloading and converting media.
spidertomp3Description: Cross-platform desktop application for downloading and converting supported media sources. It includes queue management, metadata, and packaging for Linux and Windows.
spiderawakeSummary: Android alarm application with interactive challenges.
spiderawakeDescription: Android alarm application built with Python, Kivy, and Java integration. It includes challenges and mini-games; reliability testing on Android is ongoing.
rehuseSummary: Backend for managing patients, exercises, and rehabilitation routines.
rehuseDescription: Physiotherapy backend for managing patients, exercises, rehabilitation routines, and PDF document generation.
